Maya H.: Hey team — saw a short spike on a Dedicated EU pool around 11:42 UTC, want to confirm where folks usually look for KV/cache saturation vs CPU throttling. need quick links and a suggested alert tweak :wave:
Tom R.: For per-pool telemetry start with Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pool-metrics — check panels: `latency_p95_per_pool`, `kv_evictions_per_min`, `pool_cpu_util` (use the pool tag) :mag:
Sasha P.: Also open the autoscale decision chart: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/autoscale/decisions?var-pool=eu-dedicated — it shows scale events and the metric that triggered them (KV lag or CPU) :point_up:
Liam O.: If you want traces, Honeycomb link: https://ui.honeycomb.io/redwood/datasets/serving/traces?query=pool%3Deu-dedicated — sample span names include `serve.request` + attrs: `kv_hit`, `kv_miss`, `batch_size`. Look at `kv_miss` spikes for cache pressure.
Maya H.: thanks — any quick log queries I can paste into Kibana for recent window? need to correlate with autoscale events and the rollout that went out earlier.
Tom R.: Use this KQL in Kibana to find pool-level errors and evict logs in last 30m:
```
service:serving AND pool_name:eu-dedicated AND (message:evict OR message:kvcache OR level:ERROR)
@timestamp:>now-30m
```
should show `kv_evict` lines with keys `evicted_items` and `latency_ms`.
Sasha P.: FYI the rollout note: `release/2026-03-16` had a change to the kv-reserve config (reduced reserve_pct from 12 -> 8) which could increase evicts under bursty load. worth checking config tag on the instances.
watcher-bot: Alert triggered: `eu-dedicated-kv-evict-rate-high` at 1734567880, threshold 50 evicts/min. See alert page: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/3456 :bell:
Liam O.: For alert tuning, consider: increase evaluation window to 5m and use p95(evict_rate) > 40 rather than instantaneous. Also add a mute rule during canaries: `tag:rollout and rollout_id:*` so noisy canary runs don't page SRE.
Maya H.: Great — I'll collect links and open a tiny runbook snippet in the eng-platform docs (will ping for review). If anyone has a prebuilt query for prefix KV cache hits vs misses ratio, drop it here. :pray: 
Tom R.: Quick ratio query (PromQL):
```
(sum(rate(kv_hits_total{pool="eu-dedicated"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(kv_requests_total{pool="eu-dedicated"}[5m])))
* 100
```
returns percent hit rate. If < 70% during the spike that's a red flag.
Sasha P.: I'll validate the grafana panels and add the honeycomb link to the dashboard. ping me once you add the runbook, Maya. :thumbsup:
Maya H.: will do, thanks all :sparkles:
